route_title: 12-layer ZnS/ZnSe with frozen outer layers and reduced step size
compilation_rationale: Compiled a 12-layer planar stack between air and germanium using coherent TMM. Layers 1–2 and 11–12 are frozen at specified thicknesses; layers 3–10 are optimized within 500–1500 nm bounds. Objectives enforce low transmittance in 3000–5000 nm and high transmittance in 8000–11000 nm. Adam-LBFGS optimizer handles thickness search. Material indices resolved locally.
